lines.cap: Every skyscraper over fifty floors has one floor the elevator won't stop at. I found out why.
lines.say: Every skyscraper over fifty floors has one floor the elevator won't stop at. I found out why.

lines.cap: Watch the numbers. Twelve. Fourteen. No thirteen. Builders say it's superstition.
lines.say: Watch the numbers. Twelve. Fourteen. No thirteen. Builders say it's superstition.

lines.cap: A night cleaner said otherwise. Her key card opened it. Once.
lines.say: A night cleaner said otherwise. Her key card opened it. Once.

lines.cap: Candles. A round table. Twelve chairs. Twelve people in hoods. Nobody spoke.
lines.say: Candles. A round table. Twelve chairs. Twelve people in hoods. Nobody spoke.

lines.cap: They all turned. At the exact same time.
lines.say: They all turned. At the exact same time.

lines.cap: Next morning her card was dead. And on her desk, a note: thank you for your service.
lines.say: Next morning her card was dead. And on her desk, a note: thank you for your service.

lines.cap: The sign on the door said: Book club. Members only. The book was about her.
lines.say: The sign on the door said: Book club. Members only. The book was about her.
